findings: Printed with the duplicate number 27.5; the catalogue key is the slug minerals.

The book gives the macro/micro dividing line as 100 mg/dL and lists potassium, magnesium and sulfur as micro-elements; the usual line is about 100 mg per day and these three are usually macro-minerals. Noted in a warning. The exercises (PDF 175-177) are not part of the lesson body.
